# Sanitized native TETJET metadata fixtures

Read-only snapshots of existing local records, captured 2026-10-24. No TETJET contact, source writes, referenced files, code, STEP/DXF or private TETMET/truss-opt material copied.

Source paths below replace the local username with `fixture-user`; use the actual local username to locate the originals. SHA256 is the hash of the original, unsanitized source file. Fixture hashes are listed separately in SHA256SUMS.

## Coverage and important missing cursor

- Queue: a real R5 refusal then acceptance for identical subject/full artefact SHA.
- Collected: verified package; verified rolling slice with incomplete labels; complete whole-request receipt in its own subdirectory.
- Steps: WAIT then successful fetch of the same subject (different invocation files), nonzero/null result_word, and rc=null interrupted/unknown outcome. Recorder reports 1.4.1; these are real historical v1 schema records, not freshly generated by the inventoried 1.1 source.
- Capacity: last complete line of the existing signal only. The declared live cursor was absent at capture; the check remains unarmed under the install HOLD. **No real cursor fixture is supplied.** No cursor has been fabricated or generated, and no reader was run to create one. A copied signal tail is not the original signal inode/offset history. Never pair it with a production cursor; the adapter should report missing cursor. A matched cursor/signal success fixture must be supplied by the native owner from an already existing approved reader record, or generated by tooling-mate in its isolated tests with explicit test authority.
- Nothing here proves a full service covered, changes any stage, or authorizes install/arm.
